## Is this in scope?

`galakz-prototype-spec.md` §2 lists what's explicitly in and out of scope for
this prototype, and §1.1 explains why. Before filing, a quick check: is this
something the spec already excludes on purpose (mech mode, grapple, more than
one enemy archetype, audio, etc.)? If so, it probably belongs in the full-game
backlog (`asteroids-design-doc.md`) rather than here.

- [ ] I checked §2 and §1.1 and this isn't already ruled out

## What problem does this solve?

What's missing or awkward right now, and for whom (the player, or you as the
tuner debugging feel).

## Proposed change

What you'd add or change. Reference the relevant spec section if there is one
(e.g. "changes §6.3 boost behaviour").

## Alternatives considered

Other ways to solve the same problem, if any.

## Does this affect a success criterion?

If this touches §3 (thread a corridor, choose to brake, recover from a wall
hit, predict the enemy, camera never hides a threat), say which one and how.s
